integrity: Proof gives an all-orders algebraic diagonalization; finite checker tests are supporting consistency checks, not a proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only convex equiangular polygons with paired parallel opposite sides; measures variation of opposite-edge pair sums, not their separate lengths; no claim for general CPPOS polygons. A historical-priority risk remains concerning early Fourier polygon methods whose original full text was inaccessible.
title: Exact Fourier stability of the Wigner-enhanced polygonal isoperimetric deficit
